# netbox_config_context_profiles (Data Source)

Lists config_context_profile objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_config_context_profiles" "test" {
  filters = [
    { name = "name", value = "test-config_context_profile" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: auto_sync_enabled, created, created__empty, created__gt, created__gte, created__lt, created__lte, created__n, data_file_id, data_file_id__n, data_source_id, data_source_id__n, data_synced, data_synced__empty, data_synced__gt, data_synced__gte, data_synced__lt, data_synced__lte, data_synced__n, description, description__empty, description__ic, description__ie, description__iew, description__iregex, description__isw, description__n, description__nic, description__nie, description__niew, description__nisw, description__regex, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, last_updated, last_updated__empty, last_updated__gt, last_updated__gte, last_updated__lt, last_updated__lte, last_updated__n, name, name__empty, name__ic, name__ie, name__iew, name__iregex, name__isw, name__n, name__nic, name__nie, name__niew, name__nisw, name__regex, owner, owner__n, owner_group, owner_group__n, owner_group_id, owner_group_id__n, owner_id, owner_id__n, q, tag, tag__any, tag__n, tag_id, tag_id__any, tag_id__n. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.

### Read-Only

- `config_context_profiles` (Attributes List) The matching config_context_profiles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config_context_profiles))

### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.

### Nested Schema for `config_context_profiles`

Read-Only:

- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `schema` (String) JSON schema the config contexts with this profile must satisfy (use jsonencode()).
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
